description: This data hub gathers harmonised geospatial data and socio-economic indicators on cross-border interaction in the European Union's border regions. It is published by the European Commission's Joint Research Centre, with Ricardo Barranco, Mert Kompil, Benedikt Herrmann, Ricardo Ferreira and Matteo Berzi as authors, and the 2025 release was issued on the JRC data catalogue in March 2026. Domains include cross-border public transport, public services, healthcare, cross-border governance, border obstacles and cooperation frameworks, and indicators are given at local administrative unit level with total resident population as the reference unit. Sources include JRC and DG REGIO units, the Committee of the Regions, the Association of European Border Regions, DG SANTE, ESPON and contractors. Files are free to download online, as spreadsheets and compressed archives, under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: the producers warn that the data inherit source errors, omissions and disaggregation assumptions and should be verified before operational use. Simulation uses: cross-border access to hospitals and other services for regional service continuity and capacity models. Related records: the cross-border patient healthcare data (data-ec-cross-border-patient-healthcare-directive-data) and the cross-border public transport routes (data-eu-cross-border-public-transport-services) cover related flows.
